name: EURO3
oneLiner: EURO3 was 3A DAO's overcollateralized euro stablecoin on Polygon and Linea, wound down in 2024 when the 3A lending protocol closed.

obituary.epitaph: 3A DAO closed the vaults on EURO3
obituary.obituary: 3A DAO phased out EURO3 with its lending protocol: no new loans after 2024-10-01, all remaining vaults closed on 2024-11-30, and the issuer's documentation now tells users not to send funds to the contracts. Supply has stayed near 22,866 EUR with no mint or burn activity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: 3A documents EURO3 as minted through collateralized vault loans and burned on repayment or redemption. That live stabilization path is a CDP mechanism, not issuer cash issuance or a NAV fund share; its reference remains the euro rather than the U.S. dollar.

collateral: Whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in 3A Vaults on Polygon and Linea, including USDC.e, DAI, WETH/ETH, USDT, WBTC, wstETH, and other wrapped or yield-bearing assets depending on chain
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized vault minting and redemption, phased out by 3A DAO in 2024: no new EURO3 loans after 2024-10-01, vaults closed and the app discontinued 2024-11-30.

notices.title: EURO3 lending wound down in 2024
notices.message: 3A DAO announced on 30 September 2024 that it was phasing out EURO3 and the 3A lending protocol on Polygon and Linea: no new loans from 1 October 2024, vaults open for redemption from 14 October 2024, and all remaining vaults closed and the lending web app discontinued on 30 November 2024.
